title: Compliance Milestone Lighthouse: Phased Gate Criteria, Risk Windows, and Uplift Plan for SSO/SAML & Audit Trails
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a single-source 'Lighthouse' milestone artifact that defines phased gate criteria, explicit risk windows, and an uplift/rollback plan for SSO/SAML and audit log deliverables. The artifact will be used by PM/Eng/Design/Trust to coordinate sprint commitments, runbook handoffs, and audit evidence collection for SOC2/ISO readiness. Focus areas: acceptance gates per phase (dev -> canary -> prod), clear signal definitions, risk windows & mitigation actions, required artifacts for evidence buckets, and owner handoffs for each gate.
acceptance_criteria: A Lighthouse milestone doc exists in Confluence with step-by-step gate criteria for Phase 0..3
Gates include clear success signals (telemetry thresholds, smoke test pass rate, infra readiness, documented PRs and runbooks)
Rollback and uplift playbook defined with contact matrix, SLAs for rollback action, and automated toggles where possible
All downstream teams (ENG, SRE, Console, Security) have signed off in the doc comments and Slack thread
Required audit artifacts mapped to evidence buckets with retention and owner assigned
notes: 2026-01-18: Kickoff meeting with Eng/Security. Agreed on 4-phase model: Phase 0 (scoping), Phase 1 (dev readiness), Phase 2 (canary + evidence collection), Phase 3 (prod + audit cutover).
2026-01-26: Security provided recommended telemetry thresholds for suspicious auth rates and audit-log completeness checks. Added to gate success signals.
2026-02-09: Eng requested adjustable risk windows to allow 48hr post-canary observation before gating to prod. Document updated to include observation window options and automated rollback triggers.
2026-02-22: Design created intake checklist for Console UX changes to expose SSO policy state and recent audit log ingestion status. Linked to console-ux ticket.
2026-03-04: PM review: condensed acceptance criteria and enumerated evidence artifacts (SSO config export, SAML metadata, audit log SC4 reports).
2026-03-08: Security sign-off pending for Phase 3 controls; scheduled deep-dive on 2026-03-12. Action: Diego to prepare runbook PR and example evidence bundles.
2026-03-10: Added dependency ENG-42821 (KV cache audit-stability), and cross-link to PM-14231 for RBAC & audit retention policy alignment.
next_steps: Prepare runbook PR with step-by-step rollback commands and automated toggles (target: 2026-03-18)
Consolidate telemetry dashboards (SRE) into a single gate portal so owners can evaluate signals quickly
Obtain formal security sign-off for Phase 3 controls and finalize evidence templates
Run tabletop with CS/Customer Success to validate evidence handoff process for enterprise onboarding
